text: Chain requests together, extracting values from responses and sharing state across requests
quote: Insomnia provides the ability to chain requests. This means you can extract values from the responses of other requests while also sharing state across requests.

text: Pre-request scripts can manipulate environment variables, auth, or request contents before sending
quote: Pre-request scripts allow you to execute tasks before a request is sent. They can be used to: * Manipulate environment variables or authentication * Manipulate the contents of the request

text: Official CLI can automate running API tests as part of existing Git-based CI workflows
quote: Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.

text: Collection Runner can automatically run multiple requests/tests in a collection with unlimited runs
quote: Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.

text: Build and iterate on OpenAPI specs directly in the app to design APIs
quote: Build and iterate on your OpenAPI specs to design your next API.

text: Cloud mock servers let you create a mock endpoint in a few steps
quote: The Insomnia Cloud mock servers allow you to create a mock endpoint in a few steps.

text: Supports making gRPC requests
quote: Insomnia supports making gRPC requests.

text: Import and export collections in formats like Postman, HAR, OpenAPI, Swagger, WSDL, and cURL
quote: Import formats: Insomnia JSON (v4), Insomnia YAML (v5), Postman v2.0/v2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, and cURL

text: Environments group variables (base URLs, tokens, credentials) applied across requests
quote: Use environments to define groups of variables that Insomnia applies across your requests. For example, you could create variables for base URLs, tokens, or credentials.

text: Can auto-generate a mock server from a natural-language prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL response, scaffolding routes and responses
quote: Creates a mock server from a prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL response. Automatically scaffolds routes, responses, and configurations.

text: Git Sync stores project data via any third-party Git repository without going through the cloud
quote: Git Sync: for Git storage using any 3rd party Git repository, without going through the cloud.

text: Role-based access control gives fine-grained control over who can access which resources
quote: Use Role-based access control (RBAC) for fine-grain control over who can access which Insomnia resources.

text: Organizations let users securely share collections and environments with colleagues
quote: Insomnia organizations allows users to share collections and environments safely and securely with their colleagues.

text: Automatically stores and resends cookies from responses like a web browser
quote: Insomnia automatically stores cookies from every response and sends them with future requests as needed, just like a web browser.

text: MCP clients can connect Insomnia to Konnect for real-time mocking, validating, and protecting requests
quote: Use MCP clients to connect Insomnia to Konnect for mocking, validating, and protecting requests in real time.

text: Can send requests via HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets
quote: With Insomnia, you can send requests via HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets.

text: Spec editor automatically lints and displays errors with type, line number, and message
quote: Automatically linted. Errors display at the bottom of the center pane and include error type, line number, and error message

text: Can generate code snippets automatically in over 12 programming languages
quote: Generate code snippets automatically in over 12 different programming languages.

text: Git Sync connects directly to your Git repository so project data stays in your own repo
quote: Git Sync connects Insomnia directly to your Git repository. Your project data stays in your repository.

text: Provides an in-app merge view to review and resolve Git sync conflicts without leaving Insomnia
quote: Insomnia opens a merge view so you can review and resolve conflicts without leaving the app.

text: Integrates with external vault service providers to automatically retrieve secret values when sending requests
quote: Insomnia supports integrating with external vault service providers to retrieve secret values automatically when sending requests.

text: Uses a GraphQL type system to provide auto-completion and linting of GraphQL queries
quote: Insomnia uses this type system to provide auto-completion and linting of GraphQL queries.

text: Allows uploading Protobuf files (single file or directory) for gRPC requests
quote: Insomnia allows you to upload Protobuf files to a request. You can upload a single file or a directory containing multiple files.

text: Dynamic mocking uses Liquid templates so mock responses can include request data or randomly generated fake data
quote: Dynamic mocking renders Liquid templates so responses can include: - Data from the request (headers, query parameters, path, or body). - Randomly generated fake data.

text: MCP Client discovers server elements, enabling you to invoke, query, or test them directly in the app
quote: The Insomnia MCP Client discovers these elements, which enables you to invoke, query, or test them directly in the app.

text: Scratch Pad workspace requires no login at all
quote: No login ever required for Scratch Pad

text: Projects can be converted between storage backends: Local Vault, Cloud Sync, or Git Sync
quote: You can convert a project to: - Local Vault - Cloud Sync - Git Sync

text: Insomnia's own servers cannot read or access sensitive project data during the sync process
quote: At no point in the sync process can the Insomnia servers read or access sensitive application project data.

text: AI can suggest commit messages to help keep Git history clear and atomic
quote: AI commit message suggestions, which help maintain clear and atomic commit histories.

text: Unlimited access to plugins, or ability to build your own
quote: Unlimited access to plugins or build your own
